executive_summary.text: Cost year 2023: direct care cost was $153.3 per resident day (46.5% of expenses); Connecticut median $167.62.
Cost year 2023: nursing home operating margin was -4.1% (Connecticut median -3.1%).
Cost year 2023: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $286,913, 2.7% of the $10,713,101 direct care cost.

Cost year 2023: dietary cost $1,592,776, $22.79 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.59). Wages $794,537 (49.9%), allocated fringe $181,353 (11.4%), non-wage costs $616,886 (38.7%). Raw food was $554,351 ($7.93 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.24).
Cost year 2023: housekeeping cost $905,390, $12.96 per resident day (Connecticut median $11.59). Wages $662,925 (73.2%), allocated fringe $151,313 (16.7%), non-wage costs $91,152 (10.1%).
Cost year 2023: laundry cost $372,713, $5.33 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.43). Wages $269,708 (72.4%), allocated fringe $61,561 (16.5%), non-wage costs $41,444 (11.1%).

Missing data: cost year 2015 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); CCN not in the current CMS Provider Information release (closed, merged or not yet listed).

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
